description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the BuzzVideoURLValidationAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for testing API endpoints such as 'getOne', and checks for unimplemented operations like update, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: BuzzURLValidationAPITest
